CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2452 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head a01006c1b46bc5acd3f2c7d8ebe1232c5f4ee2a3. Bus nonce: 79d8ef828f8b4d8fa5dde25cf3da5733. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly; this round's reviewer measures with the finder's harness. Earlier rounds' verdicts are the PR's `Fix review:` comments: say which round this is. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin a01006c1b46bc5acd3f2c7d8ebe1232c5f4ee2a3`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: <merge|blocked> a01006c1b46bc5acd3f2c7d8ebe1232c5f4ee2a3` for merge, or `Fix review: blocked a01006c1b46bc5acd3f2c7d8ebe1232c5f4ee2a3 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets) for blocked, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 79d8ef828f8b4d8fa5dde25cf3da5733`. Put the evidence in an `ev/` directory beside it, including `ev/HEAD` holding the 40-hex head you measured, under /tmp/seat/rev2452/. Do NOT run bus.sh: the dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, and the orchestrator publishes the verdict there. Return it on a probe ref, and push nothing else: `cd /tmp/seat/rev2452 && rm -rf pr && git init -q pr && cp -r verdict.md ev pr/ && git -C pr add -A && git -C pr -c user.name=hpo-seat -c user.email=hpo-seat@users.noreply.github.com commit -qm "verdict 2452 a01006c1b46bc5acd3f2c7d8ebe1232c5f4ee2a3" && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer fetch -q /tmp/seat/rev2452/pr HEAD && git -C /home/user/heatpump_optimizer push -q origin FETCH_HEAD:refs/heads/probe/rev-2452-79d8ef82`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except that probe ref. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in the verdict instead.
